facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 53°F at pass elevation.
No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

reports.text:
Trail closed as of 8/1/25 due to Bear Gulch Fire
Expect to encounter snow and challenging route finding conditions along this route during the winter and into early summer on a typical year. Ice axe recommended due to the number of steep, exposed slopes traversed on route, especially near Lake Sundown/Sundown Pass

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 24 to 32 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Mt. Tebo
evidence.detail: left April 20; earlier seasons: May 31 (2023), May 15 (2024), May 15 (2025)

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 13 (2024), June 15 (2025)

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 5 (2024), June 9 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Mt. Tebo
evidence.detail: 6.0 in on April 4; earlier seasons: 46.3 in (2023), 17.4 in (2024), 26.6 in (2025)

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: 28.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 54.9 in (2023), 36.2 in (2024), 54.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: 14.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 43.4 in (2023), 22.0 in (2024), 36.7 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 23 and June 12, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Mt. Tebo
evidence.detail: melted out April 20, 1,269 ft below the pass; points to April 11 to June 12

evidence.name: Buckinghorse
evidence.detail: melted out May 20, 201 ft above the pass; points to April 23 to June 8

evidence.name: Mount Crag
evidence.detail: melted out May 8, 689 ft below the pass; points to April 23 to June 16
